top_signals.title: US launches further strikes on Iran as conflict flares up
top_signals.summary: Escalation pushes oil prices higher and sends Treasury yields to day’s highs as investors fret over new bout of inflation
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Social-media age bans won’t make children safer — but this will
top_signals.summary: A more effective strategy to protect young people would force tech firms to remove addictive features by holding them to product-liability standards—as with most other industries.
